name: Military
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of military service and warfare as part of the human experience, emphasizing God's presence and strength in times of battle. Believers are encouraged to be courageous and unafraid, trusting that the Lord who delivered His people from Egypt is with them in conflict (Deuteronomy 20:1; Joshua 1:9). The Bible recognizes both a time for war and a time for peace (Ecclesiastes 3:8), affirming that God equips His people for battle and sustains them through His righteous power (Psalms 144:1; Isaiah 41:10). Even as wars and rumors of wars arise, believers are called to remain steadfast, understanding these events as part of God's sovereign plan (Matthew 24:6).
